summary_1line: After the princes’ weddings and departure from Mithila, ominous signs appear on the journey as the fearsome sage-warrior Parasurama suddenly arrives.

image_candidates.scene_text: As Rama’s wedding party travels home, the earth quakes and a blinding dust storm darkens the sky while soldiers panic around the calm princes and sages.
Parasurama appears from the dust with matted hair, a battle-axe on his shoulder and a blazing bow in hand, glowing like fire at the end of the world.
King Dasaratha anxiously questions sage Vasistha while frightened deer dash across the road and ominous birds shriek overhead.
